title: Thyroid Carcinoma (Well-Differentiated): Perioperative Management
mission: Preoperative path for biopsy-proven well-differentiated thyroid carcinoma without known locoregional metastasis, from birth through 25 years.
checkpoints: Confirm papillary or follicular carcinoma on fine-needle aspiration and no clinical or ultrasound locoregional disease.
Stop over age 25, for known locoregional metastasis, for medullary or anaplastic carcinoma, and in pregnancy.
Follow the preoperative consult, laboratory, and consent steps in the pathway.
